metadata.description: Half-degree historical exposure cells derived from UCDP organized-violence events; exact event locations, actors, narratives, and source text are not republished.
metadata.quality_note: Aggregates 2016-2025 events into approximately 55 km cells. Fatalities are UCDP low/best/high estimates, not independently verified atlas findings. Annual release only; no candidate or live feed.
metadata.label: Historical Organized-Violence Exposure (UCDP, 2016–2025)
